title: Solent Kestrels claim NBL1 Playoff title
description: Solent completed their league, cup and playoff treble with a hard-fought 74-66 victory against Worcester Wolves. In a fitting showpiece between the top-two D1M sides during the regular-season, Solent found a way to just edge ahead of a dogged opponent, as they have so many times in recent years. Drawing from across their deep roster to get themselves over the line, Solent's shared load was demonstrated by six different players contributing six or more points to the Kestrels' total, allowing the South coast programme to win their first D1M title since 2021/22. Solent's lead flirted with the 15-point mark in both the second and fourth quarter, but credit to the Wolves as they fought back on both occasions to threaten a mighty comeback.
